baseline_models.focus_anchor: The paired verbs يَبْسُطُ and يَقْدِرُ govern الرِّزْقَ in one construction.
baseline_models.mechanism: Provision is an apportioned field that can be spread into width or confined to a small measure; the opposition describes two active modes of distribution rather than two different providers.

activation_trace.role: Spreading and extension supply the opening movement of the distributive pair.
An allotted gift or share identifies what is being distributed, not merely cash wealth.
Narrowing something to a small measure supplies the counter-movement to spreading.

changed_reading.before: My Lord gives some people more provision and others less.
changed_reading.after: My Lord actively ranges apportioned provision between unfolded width and fitted restriction; both poles belong to one distributive operation.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: رَبِّى is the subject, and لِمَن يَشَآءُ places both movements under one will.
baseline_models.mechanism: Ownership, nurture, and willing combine so that allocation appears as continuing lordly governance, not as an automatic market signal or an uncontrolled fluctuation.

activation_trace.role: Lordship as ownership and command locates distributive authority in the named subject.
Repair, nurture, and completion add an ongoing formative role to that authority.
Will related to bringing about a thing makes the variation intentional rather than self-explanatory.
The allotted-share image makes governance concrete as apportionment.

changed_reading.before: The verse reports that unequal provision occurs by divine choice.
changed_reading.after: The verse presents unequal provision as a continuing act of owning, tending, and apportioning whose rationale cannot be read directly from the amount received.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ interrupts the allocation statement with a claim about human knowing.
baseline_models.mechanism: Numerical prevalence and ordinary human visibility do not yield disclosure: the majority can observe an allocation while failing to recognize what it marks or how it should be read.

activation_trace.role: Growth in number supplies the demographic force of the majority without granting it epistemic weight.
Seeing, sensing, or noticing supplies the limited perceptual horizon associated with the human collective.
Disclosure to a knower defines precisely what the majority lacks.
A distinguishing mark adds the possibility that provision is visible as a sign yet remains misread.

changed_reading.before: Most people are unaware that God controls provision.
changed_reading.after: Most people can see the quantities yet still fail to know what those quantities signify; visibility and consensus are explicitly separated from knowledge.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: قُلْ makes the entire proposition a commanded utterance.
baseline_models.mechanism: The allocation claim functions as an authorized public correction: speech is made to signify against a prevalent but unstated inference, rather than serving only as detached description.

activation_trace.role: Bringing speech into audible expression makes the proposition an intervention in discourse.
A thing's saying as its signification lets the utterance correct how observed provision is made to signify.
Competitive superiority by number supplies the kind of majority metric the commanded statement resists.

changed_reading.before: The verse states a doctrine about who receives wealth.
changed_reading.after: The verse commands a counter-reading to be spoken into a field where numerical and material superiority is already being treated as evidence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The David sequence turns measure into material design: softened iron becomes complete covering only when its connected rings are deliberately sized. This revises spreading and restriction into complementary openness and constraint that make provision serviceable and protective.

activation_trace.role: Extension supplies the open material movement that needs form.
Restriction to a small measure anchors the focus-side limiting operation.
Softness against roughness makes iron workable rather than merely abundant.
Hard, resistant iron supplies the material whose usefulness depends on shaping.
Length and breadth sufficient to cover define the desired expansive result.
Deliberate measuring and fitting supply the design operation that makes expansion functional.
Pierced, linked rings show constraint producing a connected protective weave.

structural_cues: 34:10 softens iron before 34:11 commands full coats and measured linking.
The same ق د ر root used for restriction in 34:36 is an imperative of design in 34:11.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies softened iron, ample covering, measured links, and connected mail; I transfer that material relation to allocation, inferring that limits can make extension usable. A live alternative is that the craft scene only illustrates exact workmanship and has no economic analogy.

changed_reading.before: Spreading is benefit and restriction is simply its negative opposite.
changed_reading.after: Spreading and restriction can be coordinated design operations: usable provision may require both room and measured boundaries, as protective breadth requires fitted links.

context_deltas.mechanism: Measured spacing in the Saba travel network produces visible, safe access; demanding greater distance converts the network into fragmentation. Restriction therefore activates as calibrated interval, not merely deprivation.

activation_trace.role: A bounded amount anchors restriction as a determinate interval.
Stable, growing good characterizes the destinations joined by the route.
Planning and measurement make movement through the route ordered and practicable.
Going and flowing identify provision here as access through a network.
Actively increasing distance supplies the rejected demand for unbounded spacing.
Tearing into scattered pieces supplies the network's reversal when calibrated access is refused.

structural_cues: 34:18 sequences blessed towns, visible waystations, measured travel, and safety.
34:19 answers the request for longer distances with dispersion and torn continuity.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies measured stages followed by a demand for distance and resulting fragmentation; I infer that the measure itself enables circulation. Alternatively, the episode may target ingratitude for travel ease rather than define all restrictive provision as infrastructure.

changed_reading.before: يَقْدِرُ means only that the quantity delivered to a person is reduced.
changed_reading.after: يَقْدِرُ can also evoke calibrated spacing that makes goods, people, and safety circulate; removing the measure may destroy access rather than enlarge it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The gardens episode renders provision as edible ecology joined to recognition of the giver; turning away is followed by one garden-system standing in place of another and abundance contracting to little residue.

activation_trace.role: Food entering and sustaining the body anchors provision beyond monetary possession.
Nurture and completion anchor the ecological system in continuing care.
Edible sustenance makes the two gardens a concrete embodiment of the focus noun.
Recognizing the gift and praising its giver supplies the recipient-side response to provision.
One thing taking another's place shows that the form of provision can be exchanged, not only incrementally reduced.
Littleness and paucity mark the contracted remainder after ecological replacement.

structural_cues: 34:15 places eating, the Lord's provision, gratitude, good land, and forgiveness in one scene.
34:16 begins with turning away and changes the two-garden ecology into another two-garden ecology of different yield.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies edible provision, a gratitude command, turning away, replacement, and little yield; I infer a relational ecology in which receipt calls for recognition and provision can change form. Alternatively, this may describe a particular collective judgment rather than a general causal rule for individual scarcity.

changed_reading.before: Provision is a divisible quantity independently handed to recipients.
changed_reading.after: Provision can be a maintained ecology whose yield, form, and durability are relational; restriction may appear as systemic replacement after a failed response, not only as a smaller payment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate frame exposes the inference that greater wealth and offspring guarantee immunity, then denies that either asset brings nearness and relocates multiplication in the recompense of faithful action. The focus verse is thus a direct refusal to treat distributed quantity as rank.

activation_trace.role: Competitive superiority by number anchors the false metric named around the focus.
An allotted share is the quantity being misconverted into status.
Expansive ease that releases its possessor identifies the social location of the boast.
Boasted numerical superiority supplies the explicit inference answered by 34:36.
Accumulated wealth names one visible store taken as proof of safety.
Descendants name the second visible store taken as proof of continuity and immunity.
The favor of those brought near supplies the rank that wealth and children cannot produce.
Increase by a matching multiple relocates true multiplication from possessions to recompense.

structural_cues: 34:35 boasts of more wealth and children and infers no punishment; 34:36 answers immediately.
34:37 repeats wealth and children, negates their power to bring near, and assigns multiplied recompense to belief and sound action.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies boast, allocation correction, denied proximity, and relocated multiplication; I infer that 34:36 blocks a prosperity-to-rank arrow. A live alternative is that material abundance may still be a good while remaining no evidence of immunity or nearness.

changed_reading.before: The verse explains why some people happen to possess more than others.
changed_reading.after: The verse breaks the evidentiary link from 'more' to 'nearer' or 'safe': amount is allocation, while nearness and multiplication operate on a different axis.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah defines knowledge through complete tracking of ingress, egress, descent, ascent, and the hidden; it also exposes agents who operate vast systems yet do not know the unseen. The majority's failure in 34:36 is therefore snapshot epistemology: inferring the whole distributive order from the visible balance.

activation_trace.role: Seeing and sensing supply the human reliance on what is presently perceptible.
Disclosure to a knower anchors the explicit epistemic deficit.
Comprehensive disclosure belongs to the subject who tracks every directional flow.
Entry into an interior supplies the input side of the distributive ledger.
Passage to the outside supplies the output side of that ledger.
Descent and arrival add vertical incoming flow beyond visible local stores.
Ascent adds vertical outgoing flow and completes the directional pattern.
The jinn's exposed nonknowledge shows that operating material abundance does not confer disclosure.
What is screened from sight marks the decisive limit behind confident visible inference.
The same numerical majority appears in the earlier refrain without acquiring epistemic authority.
The exact nonknowing refrain links failure about provision to a broader failure to grasp the warning's scope.

structural_cues: 34:2 opens with four directional processes under divine knowledge.
34:14 makes a collapsed support expose the jinn's ignorance of the unseen despite their productive works.
34:28 repeats أَكْثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ before the identical clause in 34:36.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies complete flow-knowledge, exposed unseen-ignorance, and the repeated majority refrain; I infer that a present amount is an inadequate sample of a hidden temporal system. Alternatively, the repeated clause may connect only at the level of generic unbelief, without specifying an economic theory of knowledge.

changed_reading.before: Most people lack one proposition: that God expands and restricts provision.
changed_reading.after: Most people mistake a visible stock for knowledge of a hidden flow; they do not know the full inputs, outputs, timing, or unseen end from which an allocation would have to be interpreted.

context_deltas.mechanism: The exact allocation pair returns in 34:39 and immediately opens into expenditure and replacement. What leaves one's possession through a traversable outlet is followed by something standing in its place, so restriction does not authorize hoarding and provision is represented as circulation rather than static inventory.

activation_trace.role: Increase and ample room anchor the expansive side of the focus pair.
Reduction to a small measure anchors the feared loss-side of the pair.
The exact expansive verb reopens the focus claim in a practical spending frame.
Allotted giving brackets the sentence as both object and provider-function.
The exact restrictive verb remains present while the sentence moves toward expenditure.
A passage with an outlet images spending as directed throughput rather than disappearance into nothing.
Something coming afterward and standing in another's place supplies the replacement movement.

structural_cues: 34:39 repeats رَبِّى يَبْسُطُ ٱلرِّزْقَ ... وَيَقْدِرُ and adds 'among His servants.'
The same ayah then sequences whatever is spent, replacement, and the superlative provider.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an exact refrain followed by outflow and succession; I infer that trust under variable provision takes the form of circulation rather than stock preservation. A live alternative is that replacement may be delayed, nonmaterial, or unlike the item spent, so the verse does not promise an immediate cash return.

changed_reading.before: Divine expansion or restriction describes a balance passively received by each person.
changed_reading.after: The balance participates in a moving economy: recipients can release provision, and the provider can place a successor after what exits, even while expansion and restriction remain real.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later summons to stand in pairs and singly and let the heart revisit the matter supplies a counter-practice to 'most people do not know': detach truth-testing from the aggregate and reconstruct judgment at smaller scales.

activation_trace.role: Numerical mass anchors the aggregate whose prevalence is denied epistemic force.
Disclosure anchors the knowledge that aggregate perception has not achieved.
Resolute rising to a matter supplies the deliberate break from passive consensus.
Joining one to one supplies a small dialogical scale for examination.
The single, separated person supplies an independent scale for judgment.
The heart's repeated turning over of a matter supplies the process by which seeing may become knowledge.

structural_cues: 34:46 sequences one exhortation, standing for God, pairs, individuals, and then reflection.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies majority nonknowledge and a later two-or-one reflective procedure; I infer that de-aggregation is an epistemic remedy for the prosperity inference. Alternatively, 34:46 directly tests the messenger's sanity and only indirectly bears on reading provision.

changed_reading.before: The final clause merely reports an unfortunate fact about public ignorance.
changed_reading.after: The final clause also anticipates a method: step outside the prestige of the majority, examine in pairs or alone, and repeatedly test what visible abundance is being made to prove.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The pot image is surprising because it is a branch-distant nominal sense of ق د ر, not the ordinary gloss of يَقْدِرُ. It remains packet-anchored through the same focus root and the standing cauldrons of 34:13; render it only as a material analogy for capacity, never as a replacement translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: يَقْدِرُ at focus word 8 shares the packet root inventory with the vessel branch.

activation_trace.role: The cooking vessel and what is bounded within it supply an exploratory capacity-image for restriction.
Large fixed cauldrons materialize provision as contents held by a stable receiving capacity.
Firm settling and fixation make the receiving vessel stable rather than infinitely expandable.

changed_reading.before: Restriction changes only how much content is put into a recipient's possession.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, restriction may also involve the sizing or fixing of receiving capacity: provision includes the vessel and its limit as well as what fills it.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's split mapping from focus ق و ل to ق ل ل and must not be treated as the lexical meaning of قُلْ. It remains anchored by that supplied mapping, the few grateful servants, the majority refrain, and solitary reflection; downstream prose should label it a form-distant sound/root resonance only.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The commanded قُلْ at word 1 is packet-mapped both to speech and, secondarily, to the root of littleness, while word 10 names the majority.

activation_trace.role: The supplied secondary mapping to paucity gives the singular command an explicitly form-distant 'small voice' resonance.
Competitive numerical superiority supplies the majority pressure facing that counter-utterance.
The few grateful servants provide a contextually real minority against which the resonance can activate.
The separated individual supplies the later scale at which a counter-reading can be carried.

changed_reading.before: قُلْ only marks who must pronounce the correction.
changed_reading.after: As a contained resonance, the correction is a deliberately small countervoice: one commanded utterance, and eventually one reflective person, stands against a socially amplified equation of abundance with truth.

strongest_changes: The immediate boast and denial of proximity turn 34:36 from a general allocation statement into a rejection of wealth as evidence of rank or immunity.
Measured armor and measured travel show ق د ر as fitted design and enabling interval, not only deprivation.
The opening flow-knowledge and the repeated majority refrain recast nonknowledge as reading a visible stock without the hidden inputs, outputs, and end.
The exact 34:39 refrain joins variable provision to expenditure and replacement, activating circulation rather than hoarding.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah context repeatedly converted the focus opposition from a flat more/less scale into mechanisms of fit, network access, ecological exchange, epistemic sampling, social rank, and circulating succession while preserving the focus roots as anchors.
remaining_uncertainties: The armor, travel, and vessel models are analogical activations; the packet does not state that every restriction is protective design or capacity-setting.
The focus attributes variation to will but does not disclose why any particular recipient is expanded or restricted.
Replacement after expenditure is explicit, but its timing, medium, and equivalence remain unspecified.
The ق و ل to ق ل ل minority resonance is licensed only by the packet's split mapping and must not be presented as ordinary lexical derivation.
